components.text:
Circle: medium circle, ritual chalk.

Turns the vampire on the centre into an Augustine: a little stronger, a bad eater of anything but vampires.
The target stands on the centre (the caster if nobody does) and must be a plain vampire: no species, not a Ghoul, not in a transition.
Whoever else is on the centre, a hybrid, a heretic or an Original is refused. A refusal gives the ingredients back.
